svg.title: Lead Scraping and Outreach Automation — architecture illustration
svg.desc: Illustration: browser control panel → FastAPI (enqueue, status) → Redis broker → Celery worker → Google Sheets. Scrape pipeline: maps_scraper → enrichment → social_enrichment → cleaning → sheets sync. Outreach: one send task per lead at +0s, +30s, +60s, writing email_status back to the sheet.
